gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-myanma: Almendra Display has a literary, ornate hand, its tall x-height keeping every letter open. Noto Sans Myanmar sets a dense, heavy-looking band of text beneath it, giving the heading something solid to stand on.
gen-eater-gf-sulphur-point: Eater is dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between its letters and short ascenders. Sulphur Point carries the text in a flat, marker-like line, bulky lowercase that stays open and easy-going.
gen-flavors-gf-stack-sans-notch: A towering, pencil-stub x-height gives Flavors its whimsical, commanding look. Stack Sans Notch brings rod-stock strokes and open curves you can see into, and that shared sturdiness is what holds the pair.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-nag-mu: Noto Sans Nag Mundari looks contemporary, with lowercase that rivals its capitals. Almendra Display excels at ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut, while the body font is best at open, half-unwrapped curves.
gen-fredoka-fs-merriweather-sans: Friendly and approachable, Fredoka has a pipe-cleaner softness to every line and an open e with a clear gap. Merriweather Sans adds tall, sturdy lowercase beneath, standing higher than Fredoka.
gen-fs-array-fs-erode: Open-ended curves with room to breathe give Array a futuristic, precise look, with large lowercase eyes. Array is for short bursts, not long paragraphs; Erode takes the editorial reading.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-fs-merriweather-sans: Code-terminal looks, generously spaced: that is Azeret Mono up top. Merriweather Sans supplies tall, sturdy lowercase, and that solid weight against fixed-width spacing is the pair's real pull.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and dense, a heavy-looking strip of text whose letters feel held open rather than curled shut. Azeret Mono adds fixed-width, code-style letters with wide tracking above.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-manrope: Fixed-width, code-style letters make Azeret Mono instantly technical. Manrope reads in a bright, rounded-nib line, with open curves and a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, so paragraphs flow smoothly.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-work-sans: Generous tracking lets every Azeret Mono word spread out like a code listing. Work Sans brings a modern, high mean line and c tips that never touch, giving the spaced-out heading a sturdy partner.
